Name: Rune Factory Custom Music and More Variety
Author: BladeOfGrass445
Description:
[center][b][size=5]﻿Rune Factory Custom Music and More Variety (RFCMaMV)[/size][/b][/center][b][size=4]
[size=3]This is a Content Patcher Mod for version 1.6+ of Stardew Valley.[/size][/size][size=3] It does not replace existing Stardew Valley musics (it only adds variety)[/size][size=4]

[/size][/b][size=3]This mod adds more variety to Stardew Valley music, with[/size][size=3] around 80 tracks from Rune Factory alternating with Stardew Valley original music.[/size][size=2] (This is done by adding the Stardew Valley tracks to the mod assets.)
[/size][size=3]Moreover, some [b]ambient [/b]tracks are replaced by musics from Rune Factory. (These new tracks are even added to the jukebox!)[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=3]Any suggestions on how to improve the mod are welcome !
(Feedback on audio mix issues is appreciated, or on which stardew valley track to add more variety)[/size][b][size=4]

Compatibility
[/size][/b][size=3]Now Compatible with [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24348]Continuous Music[/url] [/size][size=3]via an option in the config file or via [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url]. [size=3]Be sure to restart the game after selecting this option.[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]
Preview of 2/80 tracks:
[/size][/b][size=4][i]Rain ambient replacement (1 of 7 tracks):[/i][/size][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][size=4][youtube]uSct6e8cQKo[/youtube]
[size=4][i]Pelican Town music variety (1 of 3 tracks):[/i][/size]
[youtube]_HPWyNzETZQ[/youtube]
[i]And a lot more to discover[/i]
[/size][b][size=4]
Warning
[/size][/b][size=3]This mod takes quite a bit of disk space (with all the musics). Make sure you have [/size][b][size=3]at least 400 MB of free disk space.[/size][size=4]

Alternative Download Link
[/size][/b][size=3][url=https://mega.nz/folder/R44C0D6J#mHHuM3RDG58rjkue76N9tQ]MEGA[/url] (388 MB)[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]
Thanks
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210652370]PlumeQoQ[/url] [/size][/b][size=3]for bringing to my attention content patcher[/size][size=3] could be used to replace the now outdated [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url][/b].[/size][size=4]
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=User:Blueberry&action=edit&redlink=1]Blueberry[/url] [/size][size=3]for writing the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Audio]wiki page about audio modding[/url], which [/size][size=3]was [/size][size=4][b]TREMENDOUSLY[/b][/size][size=3] helpful to create this mod.[/size][size=4]
[/size][b][size=4]
[b][size=4]Credits
[/size][/b][/size][/b][size=3]There was previously a Rune Factory Custom Music mod uploaded on Nexus, I reused most of its tracks. (Though I added double the amount)[/size][size=4].
[/size][b][size=4]
Disclaimer[/size]
[/b][size=3]I do not own Rune Factory and its musics. [i]Though I do own the games.
[/i][/size]


[size=2][u]Changelog:
[/u][/size][list]
[*][size=2]1.0.8 : Better compatibility with [size=2]Continuous Music[/size]. No lost tracks.[/size]
[*][size=2]1.0.7 : Make use of ogg by default as they are better compressed. Fix crashes on android.[/size]
[*][size=2]1.0.6 : Added compatibility with Continuous Music by adding an option to turn off Seasonal Ambient Replacements (Losing 3 tracks each seasons)[/size]
[*][size=2]1.0.5 : Fixed Mine Music Loop. Added 3 more tracks to rain ambient.[/size]
[*][size=2]1.0.2 : Bugfixes and added marnieShop and Wizard Stardew music that were missing.[/size]
[/list][size=2][list]
[*][size=2]1.0.1 : Lowered the volume of the music to fit better with vanilla. (Normalized to Perceived loudness of -20 LUFS).[/size]
[/list][/size][list]
[*][size=2]1.0 : Initial upload with 105 musics variants (including Stardew Valley music) and 35 ambient music replacements (with variants).[/size]
[/list]
[size=1]When browsing the assets:
_sdv signifies the music is from Stardew Valley
_rune denotes that the music is from the previous version of Custom Music Rune Factory
_rune1, _rune2, etc. These signify whether the track is from Rune Factory 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.[/size]
